findings.title: Hardcoded list breaks naming consistency
findings.body: The new hardcoded list of checks (`lint`, `typecheck`, `test`) is not extracted into a constant, which violates the local convention of defining constants at the top of the file. This also makes the component less maintainable and harder to extend.

findings.title: Magic number 3 in component body
findings.body: The component renders exactly three list items without explanation. While the number is small, it is not self-documenting and could become a maintenance burden if the list grows. A constant or a comment explaining the purpose of these three checks would improve clarity.
findings.suggestion:
const CHECK_NAMES = ["lint", "typecheck", "test"] as const;

// Required checks enforced by the CI pipeline

summary.problem: The component hardcodes the list of required checks inline, breaking naming consistency and reducing maintainability.
summary.done_well: The component structure is clean and the list items are rendered consistently.
